title: File:US Navy 051028-N-9769P-002 Senior Chief Navy Counselor David Paradise, assigned to Commander Naval Recruiting Command, receives his annual Influenza vaccine in the form of a nasal mist.jpg
art: U.S. Navy photo by Photographer’s Mate 2nd Class Jayme Pastoric
desc: Millington, Tenn. (Oct. 28, 2005) – Senior Chief Navy Counselor David Paradise, assigned to Commander Naval Recruiting Command, receives his annual Influenza vaccine in the form of a nasal mist. The painless vaccine, called FLUMIST, is sprayed into a person’s nostrils rather than injected by needle.
